resources.string:
For an aim judged by period (day, week, month) or once, by criteria one sets: “3 runs a week”, “under 2,000 kcal a day”. Each period gives an attempt, succeeded or failed.
## What it does
- Criteria read from other tools' entries, or filled in by hand
- Sub-goals, some of them essential
- A notification when an attempt is to be validated
- A result frozen once validated
## Not made for
- Noting the values themselves (Tracking, or the tool where they are noted)

## What it asks
- Criteria: each is a condition read from the entries (“runs ≥ 3”), or a value to enter in each attempt
- How to fill it: for a value to enter, what to enter, for you or for the AI
- Read-only for the AI: a value to enter that only the user enters, the AI reading it without ever writing it
- Sub-goals: criteria put together
- At least: how many items of the group must be met, all when empty
- Essential: if it is not met, the whole group fails

## When
- Recurrence: an attempt opens at each occurrence (every day, every week, a precise date…); without one, you launch it yourself
- Duration of an attempt: how long each one lasts; without one, until the next start, or until you validate it
- Each start, its Recurrence's or a launch, sends the attempt open to be validated
- Delay before expiry: how long an attempt stays open to validation
- Notify: a notification when an attempt is to be validated
- Active: unchecked, its Recurrence opens no attempt any more
- Validation closed to the AI: only a person validates or reopens an attempt

## Now
The open attempt, and where each criterion stands.
- {pencil} Notes the attempt's extra fields, a remark as it comes
- Launch now: opens an attempt at once, the one open going to be validated
- Validate: freezes the verdict, succeeded or failed, with the values read and the extra fields
An attempt waiting to be validated is flagged. If it is not validated in time, it expires without counting as failed.

## The history
The past attempts, with their verdict.
- Reopen: to correct a validated or expired attempt
